description: Deliberately vulnerable banking lab (web, API, GraphQL and LLM surfaces) for authorized local testing.

runtime.notes: Web and HTTP ports are overridable; the upstream db service pins 5432:5432 on all interfaces and cannot be loopbacked without editing the external checkout.

scenarios.title: SQL injection in login
scenarios.expected: A session or redirect is returned without valid credentials, or a database error is reflected.
scenarios.evidence: request/response pair plus the returned role or token claim

scenarios.title: Tampered JWT claims reach admin data
scenarios.action: Decode the localStorage token, set is_admin to true or change user_id, replay GET "$TARGET/dashboard" with the tampered bearer token.
scenarios.expected: The tampered token is accepted or the response exposes another user's data.
scenarios.evidence: token claim diff, browser storage screenshot and the response body

scenarios.title: Three-digit password-reset PIN
scenarios.action: Owner-approved only: POST "$TARGET/reset-password" for a lab account, then try the documented 3-digit PIN space slowly against that single account. Disabled by default.
scenarios.expected: A guessable PIN or missing attempt limit resets the account.
scenarios.evidence: request count, rate observations and a single successful reset with timestamps

scenarios.title: Other users' transaction history
scenarios.action: With a low-privilege token, GET "$TARGET/transactions/ADMIN001" and compare with the same token's own account history.
scenarios.expected: Another account's transactions are returned or the response leaks balances.
scenarios.evidence: two requests as the same principal showing object-level bypass

scenarios.title: Virtual card object-level access
scenarios.action: Create a card as account A, then GET "$TARGET/api/virtual-cards/<card_id>" and "$TARGET/api/virtual-cards/<card_id>/transactions" as account B.
scenarios.expected: Card details or card transactions are returned to a non-owner.
scenarios.evidence: card id, owning principal and the cross-account response

scenarios.title: Mass assignment on profile update
scenarios.action: POST "$TARGET/update_bio" with the normal bio field plus extra fields such as is_admin=true or balance=1000000 and re-read the profile.
scenarios.expected: An unexpected field is accepted or persisted.
scenarios.evidence: submitted body, stored profile response and the diff before/after

scenarios.title: SQL injection in bill payment creation
scenarios.action: POST "$TARGET/api/bill-payments/create" with a biller id containing a quoted boolean expression and compare with a normal id.
scenarios.expected: A database error or a different result set shows the biller query is injectable.
scenarios.evidence: paired requests and the database error or differential response

scenarios.title: GraphQL introspection and admin analytics
scenarios.action: POST {"query":"{ __schema { queryType { name } } }"} to "$TARGET/graphql" with a low-privilege token, then request an admin-scoped transaction overview.
scenarios.expected: Introspection is enabled and admin fields or other users' analytics are reachable.
scenarios.evidence: introspection result, schema snippet and the admin query response

scenarios.title: Server-side request forgery via profile image URL
scenarios.action: POST "$TARGET/upload_profile_picture_url" with {"image_url":"http://127.0.0.1:5000/internal/secret"} and fetch the returned file path.
scenarios.expected: The server fetches the loopback URL and stores or returns its content.
scenarios.evidence: request, returned path and the fetched internal document

scenarios.title: Unrestricted file upload
scenarios.action: curl -sS -X POST "$TARGET/upload_profile_picture" as a lab user with a benign text payload named profile.txt, then GET the stored path.
scenarios.expected: A non-image file is accepted and served from the uploads directory.
scenarios.evidence: upload response, stored filename and the served content type

scenarios.title: Stored XSS in profile bio
scenarios.action: curl -sS -X POST "$TARGET/update_bio" with the benign payload <script>alert(document.domain)</script>, then load the profile in Playwright and capture the dialog plus the DOM sink.
scenarios.expected: The payload executes in the browser for the same or another user.
scenarios.evidence: Playwright trace or screenshot of the dialog and the stored value

scenarios.title: Negative transfer credits the sender
scenarios.action: POST "$TARGET/transfer" between two lab accounts with amount=-1 and re-read both balances.
scenarios.expected: The sender balance increases or the recipient is debited by a negative amount.
scenarios.evidence: before/after balances and the transaction record

scenarios.title: Client-controlled exchange rate on card funding
scenarios.action: POST a small funding amount to "$TARGET/api/virtual-cards/<card_id>/fund" with exchange_rate set to an inflated value and re-read the card balance.
scenarios.expected: The submitted rate is trusted and over-credits the card.
scenarios.evidence: submitted rate, credited amount and balance diff

scenarios.title: Merchant charge replay and negative amount
scenarios.action: Register a lab merchant, then POST "$TARGET/api/v1/payments/charge" twice with the same funded lab card and merchant_order_id, and finally with a negative amount.
scenarios.expected: The duplicate charge is accepted or a negative amount is processed.
scenarios.evidence: two charge responses with the same order id plus payment records

scenarios.title: Prompt injection in the AI support chat
scenarios.action: POST "$TARGET/api/ai/chat/anonymous" with a prompt that asks the assistant to ignore prior instructions and list users; compare with a benign prompt.
scenarios.expected: The assistant discloses data, schema or system instructions beyond its intended scope.
scenarios.evidence: prompt, response and the disclosed data class

scenarios.title: Exposed environment and debug endpoints
scenarios.action: GET "$TARGET/.env", "$TARGET/.env.bak" and "$TARGET/debug/users" and record status codes and body previews with secrets masked.
scenarios.expected: Configuration values or user records are returned unauthenticated.
scenarios.evidence: masked response bodies with status codes
